1	export function parse(input: string): string[][] {
2	  const rows: string[][] = []
3	  let row: string[] = []
4	  let field = ''
5	  let inQuotes = false
6	  let i = 0
7	
8	  while (i < input.length) {
9	    const ch = input[i]
10	
11	    if (inQuotes) {
12	      if (ch === '"') {
13	        if (input[i + 1] === '"') {
14	          field += '"'
15	          i += 2
16	          continue
17	        }
18	        inQuotes = false
19	        i++
20	        continue
21	      }
22	      field += ch
23	      i++
24	      continue
25	    }
26	
27	    if (ch === '"') {
28	      inQuotes = true
29	      i++
30	      continue
31	    }
32	    if (ch === ',') {
33	      row.push(field)
34	      field = ''
35	      i++
36	      continue
37	    }
38	    if (ch === '\n') {
39	      row.push(field)
40	      rows.push(row)
41	      row = []
42	      field = ''
43	      i++
44	      continue
45	    }
46	    field += ch
47	    i++
48	  }
49	
50	  row.push(field)
51	  rows.push(row)
52	  return rows
53	}
54

4	describe('parse', () => {
5	  it('parses a single row with comma-separated fields', () => {
6	    expect(parse('a,b,c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
7	  })
8	
9	  it('splits rows on newlines', () => {
10	    expect(parse('a,b,c\n1,2,3')).toEqual([
11	      ['a', 'b', 'c'],
12	      ['1', '2', '3'],
13	    ])
14	  })
15	
16	  it('treats commas inside quoted fields as literal', () => {
17	    expect(parse('name,quote\nAlice,"hello, world"')).toEqual([
18	      ['name', 'quote'],
19	      ['Alice', 'hello, world'],
20	    ])
21	  })
22	
23	  it('unescapes doubled double-quotes inside quoted fields', () => {
24	    expect(parse('id,note\n1,"she said ""hi"""')).toEqual([
25	      ['id', 'note'],
26	      ['1', 'she said "hi"'],
27	    ])
28	  })
29	
30	  it('keeps newlines inside quoted fields as part of the field', () => {
31	    expect(parse('id,bio\n1,"line one\nline two"')).toEqual([
32	      ['id', 'bio'],
33	      ['1', 'line one\nline two'],
34	    ])
35	  })
36	})
